phase: I-A — AUDIT of existing Meta/social ingestion

ig: media_url / thumbnail_url — NOT REQUESTED from Graph API
media dimensions / aspect ratio — NOT stored
fb: full_picture — REQUESTED but NOT stored in sidecar

what_works: IG fetcher lists media since/until timestamp window
FB fetcher lists page posts with metrics
Performance metrics (reach, engagement_rate, reactions, clicks) are captured
Hook IDs generated from caption first line (deduplication key)
what_doesnt_work: No media URL stored → cannot display post thumbnails in creative reference library
No full caption → cannot extract copy patterns or recurring phrases
No hashtags → cannot search by hashtag or brand campaign
No brand classification (curated/published/strong/old system/campaign) — these are creative-intelligence concepts that don't exist in the data model
No creative search by brand voice / pattern / colour
Performance not linked to specific posts in the lineage graph
No 'use as reference' / 'strong brand example' / 'do not learn' classifications
what_to_extend_not_rebuild: Add media_url + thumbnail_url to IG fetcher fields param
Add full_picture + message_full + hashtags to FB fetcher output
Build a brand-directory/social-history.json that stores the extended post records
Add ingestion endpoint that triggers the fetcher + downloads thumbnails
Add /api/creative/search that searches both curated + social posts
Add /api/social/posts/<platform>/<post_id>/classify endpoint to mark a post as STRONG / DO NOT LEARN / etc.
key_decisions_to_ask_christelle: Stick doesn't have IG/FB accounts configured — only Takomo appears as a brand in brand-directory/stick. Confirm which IG/FB account IDs are canonical.
Bag Drop doesn't have IG/FB accounts configured in scripts/fetch_*.py — need the FB Page ID + IG Business ID.
Should the social history be ingested continuously (cron) or only on-demand?
Should 'do not learn' classifications automatically exclude the post from creative_director.compose_prompt's reference_dna search? (recommended: yes)

Extend FB fetcher: store full_picture + message_full + hashtags + linked_url
Add fetch_social_history.py — downloads thumbnails + builds social-history.json
phase_I-C_classification: Add /api/creative/search that searches BOTH curated AND published with brand weighting
phase_I-D_run_test: Test 11: Stick/Takomo reference + published history search → visual patterns → generate
